summary: Evidence-only documents on an onboarding batch at any stage before execution: append-only onboarding_evidence (uploader, timestamp, filename, sha256, purpose, stage at attach) written only through onboarding_register_evidence (refused in execute/post_proof/complete), read through onboarding_evidence_view. Source reports, cutoff dates, stages and recorded results are untouched.

preflight.name: onboarding_append_only exists (481)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'onboarding_append_only'

preflight.name: onboarding_evidence does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'onboarding_evidence'

expected_changes: Creates append-only table onboarding_evidence (FKs to conversion_batches and communities, RESTRICT; sha256/bytes/purpose/kind CHECKs; UNIQUE (batch_id, sha256)) with an index and the append-only trigger.
Creates functions onboarding_register_evidence(UUID, JSONB, TEXT, TEXT) (refused in execute/post_proof/complete) and onboarding_evidence_view(UUID); EXECUTE for service_role only.
No onboarding_artifacts, conversion_batches or stage-event row changes.

verify.name: evidence table exists and is empty
evidence is append-only (trigger present)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'trg_onboarding_evidence_append_only'

verify.name: the register function refuses after execution starts
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'onboarding_register_evidence' AND prosrc LIKE '%''execute'', ''post_proof'', ''complete''%'

verify.name: service_role can execute both functions, PUBLIC cannot
verify.sql: SELECT (CASE WHEN has_function_privilege('service_role', 'onboarding_register_evidence(uuid, jsonb, text, text)', 'EXECUTE') AND has_function_privilege('service_role', 'onboarding_evidence_view(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') AND NOT has_function_privilege('anon', 'onboarding_register_evidence(uuid, jsonb, text, text)', 'EXECUTE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int
